scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,vite -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:clean: sh -c 'lsof -ti:3001 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:5173 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:5174 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null' && npm run dev
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
